hints: The height climbed is the area under the speed–time graph. What shape is it?
worded:
1. The lift moves only upward, so height = area under the graph.

2. The graph is a trapezium: 0 to 3.6 m/s in 2 s, steady until 10 s, back to 0 at 12 s.

3. Area = average of the parallel sides × height = ½(12 + 8) × 3.6 = 36 m. (C)

4. Trap: 28.8 m (B) counts only the steady part; 3.6 m (A) is just the speed.
mistakes: Include the speeding-up and slowing-down triangles, not just the constant-speed rectangle.
